goal: Preserve checked model decisions and original byte facts in immutable records and nongit release snapshots

components.summary: Preserve original requests, checked PLAN/model provenance and immutable change records; copy independent byte identities only after successful nongit releases and derive request/release history from those facts.
responsibilities: preserve original owner request bytes and sidecars
derive visible request facts without mutable status
parse owner-linked PLAN changes and verify explicitly planned function changes against their real baseline
state: original owner request bytes and immutable sidecars
side_effects: writes request files, change record pairs, raw-byte guards and independent written receipts

components.summary: Check one target against real source and bound tests, promote the checked bytes, preserve their PLAN/rule evidence in immutable records and give reviewed staging and real message-file commit guidance.
responsibilities: start, extend and drop one target; move tracked in-place edits safely and retain current files otherwise

classify merged-tree design errors, semantic rule changes, moved rules and native gaps before or after code changes; run the changed target models own bound tests and reject unreceived escalated outputs
mark only the breakage of a changed subject as moving to target
refuse a target that changes nothing, drops a promise or leaves it untied

promote checked bytes atomically with transient recovery copies and name draft or stale components to confirm; list re-reads and deletions; print absolute literal-file staging guidance including target deletion, or honest no-Git preservation and verification guidance, without changing the Git index

warn about earlier findings, stale active debts, untested rules, fingerprint-format changes and siblings that ignore a newly received parent field; evaluate version debts against the actual project root
include function-selected models and tests in the single promotion check
link stored requests to the target and publish an immutable change record after successful application and target cleanup
side_effects: writes current .flowguard/map.json and .flowguard/models/ only after a clean target check
publishes immutable change record pairs after successful application and target cleanup

components.summary: Dispatch public commands with stable exits and advice; run complete release gates before persisting nongit byte/release facts and printing the final verdict, while static status stays read-only.
responsibilities: parse command lines and dispatch them to their owners Confirmation writes format 2 pointers and upgrades the map after all confirmed pointers are current. Model-running commands accept jobs 1-32, default to min(4, CPUs), and retain explicit --jobs 1 serial execution; the hidden verify alias keeps its existing surface. The change --verbose flag displays exact selected pytest commands.
show complete owners, closest owners, target changes, Mermaid and reviews in read; folded child names lead to full component views
annotate planned target breakage and ARCH lines in check, change and release; show fingerprint-format reminders in change

run release with the system root counted and optional whole-suite shards; reject expired debts in strict release checks and display explicit debt deadlines; reject already-applied committed targets and target deletions not staged, preserving the warning for real open targets
run bound tests and, on request, the checks an edit needs
write templates and their aliases into the active target when one exists
hint splits for large scan drafts and say when discovery finds nothing
side_effects: writes .flowguard/map.json on scan, deps --write and confirm
